# Nicheformer

## Takeaway

Nicheformer is a foundation model for single-cell and spatial omics that can transfer representations across spatial context and tissue neighborhoods.

## Input and output

- Input: spatial transcriptomics or dissociated single-cell data plus a compatible checkpoint.
- Output: niche embeddings and spatial-context predictions.
- Record: platform, tissue, coordinate system, preprocessing, checkpoint and external validation set.

## Official material

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02814-z
- Code: https://github.com/theislab/nicheformer
- Model card: https://huggingface.co/collections/theislab/nicheformer
- Turnkey entry: python/04_nicheformer_template.py.

## Limitation

Domain shift across tissues and platforms can be substantial. Treat predictions as a research branch until validated with spatial or molecular evidence.
